messages:
jill_sales: FYI - FinBank requests BYO-KMS for upcoming 2-week POC. They want HSM-backed keys (prefer Thales Luna), envelope encryption, quarterly rotation with signed ceremony log, and an audit copy retained. What do we need to accept this and ship the POC?

teja_se: Need concrete inventory from them: HSM vendor + cluster IDs, management endpoint type (public vs private), VPC peering details, and an admin contact. Also confirm whether Redwood will perform wrap/unwrap or just call their wrap API.

jill_sales: They said Thales Luna in us-east-1, private endpoint, Redwood should perform envelope wrap/unwrap using their key via remote PKCS#11. Admin contact is ops-lead@finbank.com.

ravi_eng: Remote PKCS#11 is doable but we need connector creds and an operator key for test. For POC we recommend a short-lived test key and a dedicated namespace. We'll ask for a service account cert and a pre-approved client IP range. I'll prepare a small terraform snippet and a connector runbook.

luna_security: Security checklist for GRC and infosec: 1) HSM attestation report (for POC, a signed attestation + cluster cert is acceptable). 2) Ceremony artifacts must be signed PDFs with SHA256 checksums; retention: we recommend 7 years for regulated finance. 3) KMS policy must explicitly allow Redwood service principal to use wrap/unwrap ops and require MFA for key rotation triggers in prod. 4) If they insist on multi-party generation in prod we need to scope separately.

frank_ops: Pricing note: for this POC we propose a one-time integration flat fee of $7,500 (includes 48 engineering hours + runbook + up to 2 ceremonies). Any infra we provision or dedicated pools will be billed pass-through. If they require pro-rated dedicated pools during POC add the monthly commit pro-rate.

teja_se: Minimal checklist to collect from FinBank before we schedule the ceremony:
- HSM vendor and cluster identifier(s)
- PKCS#11 endpoint (hostname:port), or CloudHSM cluster id
- VPC peering CIDR and allowed egress IPs
- Service account cert / connector credentials and IAM role ARN if using AWS KMS
- Preferred ceremony window and signatory list

ravi_eng: Example IAM policy we'll ask for if they use AWS KMS wrapper (send as example only):
```
{
  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Statement": [
    {
      "Effect": "Allow",
      "Principal": { "AWS": "arn:aws:iam::REDSRV:role/redwood-connector" },
      "Action": ["kms:Encrypt","kms:Decrypt","kms:GenerateDataKey","kms:ReEncrypt*"],
      "Resource": "arn:aws:kms:us-east-1:999999999999:key/*"
    }
  ]
}
```

infra-bot: POC integration sandbox (rbw-integ-902) created. Runbook workspace ready.

teja_se: I'll draft the pre-ceremony packet and send to ops-lead@finbank.com today. If they accept the $7.5k one-time, we can get the SOW signed and schedule the ceremony next Tue.

jill_sales: Thanks team, please cc legal on the SOW for the BYO KMS clause. I'll update the opportunity with the new fee and timeline.
